ci-bot: [CI] build on main failed after merge (automerge). pipeline #4021 - step: smoke/gpu-matrix on node gpu-7 failed. logs: https://ci.redwood.example/4021/logs
elinor: ugh, saw this. @samir can you grab? looks like the new kv-cache change landed in that PR 5678
samir: taking a look, will kick a rerun. if it flakes again we'll bisect. starting rerun now -> https://ci.redwood.example/4021/retry/1
ci-bot: rerun #1 started by samir (queued on gpu-3)
gideon: is this the PR that touched allocator/pinned-memory? @elinor
elinor: yes touched allocator + a small change in kv eviction path, but tests passed locally for me
samir: rerun finished -> FAIL. same test failing: tests/smoke/test_gpu_inference.py::test_end_to_end_smoke
samir: tail of the error: ```RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory during matrix_attention at runtime/kernel_launch.cpp:87
Last frames:
  File "./infer.py", line 423, in forward
  File "./tests/smoke/test_gpu_inference.py", line 58, in test_end_to_end_smoke```
tanya: I can run a bisect if you want me to. what range do we suspect?
samir: let's bisect HEAD~8..HEAD to be safe. I can start the bisect job but need someone to hold alerts and watch for flaky spikes, @ops-duty?
ops-duty: ack, I'll silence pager for 10m and monitor. initiating rollback hold for automerge while we bisect :hourglass:
gideon: quick suggestion: try setting BATCH_SIZE=1 in the smoke job to see if it's pure memory pressure vs logic change
elinor: yeah try batch=1 as a quick probe before full bisect
samir: started a prob run with BATCH_SIZE=1 -> https://ci.redwood.example/4021/try-probe. if that passes we know it's alloc pressure
ci-bot: probe run finished -> PASS (batch_size=1)
samir: probe passed. confirms memory regression. starting git bisect across commits HEAD~8..HEAD, will post culprit when found
tanya: ping me when bisect narrows to 2 commits, I can take a deeper look. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: git-bisect job queued: https://ci.redwood.example/4021/bisect/1
samir: thanks everyone. leaving notes in the PR and will update here with the first bad commit. ops-duty keeping automerge paused until we have a hotfix or revert
elinor: good plan. adding a short regression test to block automerge until we have root cause
gideon: thanks for the quick response team.
ops-duty: rollback still held, will unhold once fix/revert is merged or after 6h if no progress (notify ops-duty if you need an exception)
